name: Velvet Requiem
source:
Taking themes from Morenatsu, and other Day-to-day Visual Novels, You will be expected to plan your day. As a new fledgeling vampire in a world where everyone wants to enslave you, study you, or consume you, how will you fare?

Will you make allies? Fall in love? Become someone's Pet? or Fall into despair as your withering mind consumes you.

Do NOT trust what you see.
Did you expect you could trust even your own eyes?

[From [url=https://laughingy33n.itch.io/velvet-requiem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
借鉴《Morenatsu》和其他日常视觉小说的主题，你将需要计划你的一天。作为一个初出茅庐的吸血鬼，身处一个人人都想奴役你、研究你或吞噬你的世界，你会如何应对？

你会结交盟友吗？爱上？成为某人的宠物？或者当你枯萎的心灵吞噬你时陷入绝望。

不要相信你所看到的。
你是否期望你甚至可以相信自己的眼睛？

[来自[url=https://laughingy33n.itch.io/velvet-requiem]Itch.io[/url]]
